This '''individual''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the militant faction of the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]], a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization opposed to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="cod" /> In [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]],<ref name="tnec" /> the famed [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Arwen Cohl]] led a group of Nebula Front members in infiltrating the ''[[Revenue]]'', a Trade Federation [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo freighter]] that was receiving a shipment of [[Lommite/Legends|lommite ore]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]]. They succeeded in stealing the hidden cargo of [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]] ingots; however, the Rodian [[Death/Legends|died]] during the mission.<ref name="cod" />
